content: When dating a convicted sex offender, concerns about trust, safety, and their ability to respect boundaries may arise. Open communication and understanding their rehabilitation process are essential, but such relationships require careful consideration, clear boundaries, and awareness of personal and legal risks. Seek professional guidance if unsure.
